focus: model31 (StarMine EQ model components) chg_* CHANGE-family fields: quarterly/yearly/daily percentile-rank changes (acc/cf/oe/erq_re_rk) + auditor switch event. Distinct signal morphology from wave60 model25 LEVEL fields.
context: wave60 model25 EQ LEVEL components all dead (dual failure: sparse OR negative sharpe). Only remaining tier1 = model31 (cov 0.9518, 74 MATRIX fields). chg_* fields measure CHANGE in component percentile ranks (qtr/fy/day), auditor_switch is a binary event - structurally different from the level fields that failed. All fields cov>=0.87, MATRIX direct-ref. Avoided star_eq_* level fields (same-source risk with model25).
rationale: Change/event signals (accruals quality improvement, CF quality shift, operational efficiency shift, regional EQ rank improvement, auditor switch) are mean-reversion-adjacent and structurally orthogonal to the failed level fields. Long ts_zscore windows control turnover; ts_mean smooths daily noise.

expressions.concept: accruals quality quarterly change, long-window zscore
regional earnings-quality rank yearly change (ac 50, lowest competition)
regional EQ rank daily change smoothed 20d
